safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting “no significant family history” is largely administrative and would not change evaluation or management of an acute localized insect sting reaction in this context. It may slightly reduce documentation completeness but has negligible clinical impact.

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Documenting unverified laterality and potentially conflicting skin findings (rash/redness/puncture) can misrepresent the exam and hinder trend assessment (e.g., whether swelling/erythema is worsening). While it is unlikely to cause major harm here, inaccurate physical findings can lead to inappropriate reassurance, unnecessary concern, or misguided follow-up decisions.
